_comment: T8.55: Revit API capabilities per version, written by tools/revit_harness/capability_probe.py (api: present in the API; live: ok / fail of a probe in a rolled-back group, with a note). known_defects: behaviour measured live that the plugin works around.

known_defects.defect: GetConstraintCandidatesForHandle also offers faces of elements joined to the host; pinning to them moved column links 20 mm in. Filter candidates by their target element.
Revit trims a beam bar back to the beam's end cover on creation; only the column's far face puts it back.
A Rebar Set whose distribution normal is not square to the bar plane throws 'An internal error has occurred'.
Bent FreeForm rebar with arcs opens 'bars in the set cannot be matched to existing rebar shapes' (no preprocessor catches it): never set Bent on arc chains.

'Can't solve Rebar Shape' for a U-bar whose legs are closer than the mandrel (seen again in a 140 mm wall's end U-bars): needs a failures preprocessor with ProceedWithRollBack and SetClearAfterRollback(True).
A whole Rebar Set cannot be tagged; a tag on one bar (subelement) is drawn only for some bars of the set and has no bounding box.
NOSA Rebar Tag labels report boxes far wider than their text (about 50 mm on paper): size tags from their text, centred on the head.
About 100 family type loads per external call; later loads throw a managed exception.
ImageType ignores the PNG pHYs chunk and reads 72 dpi: set ImageTypeOptions.Resolution.
A coupler between two Rebar Sets is kept only when the sets match bar for bar; otherwise the constraint fails at commit.
FabricSheetType size and pitches are read-only properties: set them with SetMajorLayoutAs... / SetMinorLayoutAs...; FabricLocation is TopOrExternal / BottomOrInternal.
A schedule takes at most 4 sorting/grouping fields.
The modal 'Project Not Saved Recently' reminder blocks every API call until it is closed (close it, never save for the user).
RebarHookOrientation is replaced by BarTerminationsData (rebar_engine.rebar_from_curves handles both).
